title: Full-Stack CTO/ Technical Lead - Assessment & AI Platform
description:
**Role Summary**

Strengthscape is building Meridian as an in\-house digital assessment, scoring, reporting and AI\-enabled insight platform. The CTO / Technical Co\-Founder will own the product architecture, build strategy, engineering execution, AI automation layer, deployment discipline, data\-security posture and future technology team formation.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on full\-stack builder who can move from concept to MVP quickly, convert assessment and psychometric logic into robust product workflows, and make pragmatic technical decisions without waiting for perfect specifications.

**Builder First**

Own the product from idea to working release. Write code, solve ambiguity and ship usable systems.

**AI\-Native**

Use AI APIs, automation and workflow tools intelligently across review, reporting and operations.

**Founder\-Track**

Operate with skin in the game, milestone accountability and long\-term ownership orientation.

**PRODUCT CONTEXT**

About Meridian

Meridian is being built to power next\-generation assessment journeys for individuals, teams and enterprise clients. It will combine assessment\-taking, item banks, scoring models, quality review, AI\-assisted reporting, dashboards and delivery workflows into one coherent platform.

The product sits at the intersection of psychometrics, leadership development, HR technology, AI\-assisted insights, learning journeys and B2B SaaS. The first priority is a secure, usable MVP that can support assessment development and real client pilots; the long\-term vision is a scalable product platform with multiple assessments, user roles and enterprise workflows.

What the CTO Will Build

· Respondent\-facing assessment web app with secure login, progress saving and accessible user experience.

· Assessment builder and item\-bank system with item metadata, versioning, review status, locking and audit trail.

· Scoring and interpretation engine with dimensions, sub\-dimensions, adaptive logic, validation checks and report mapping.

· Admin, reviewer, consultant and client dashboards for review, publishing, delivery tracking and report access.

· AI\-assisted workflows for item review, quality checks, insight drafting, report generation and human approval.

· Secure data architecture for users, accounts, responses, scoring outputs, reports, exports, logs and permissions.

· Integrations with relevant tools such as Google Workspace, Notion, Zoho, CRM systems, payment workflows and AI APIs.

· Deployment, backup, monitoring, error logging, documentation and release discipline for production readiness.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Technology Ownership

· Define and own the technology roadmap for Meridian from MVP to production\-grade platform.

· Choose the right architecture, stack, database, hosting environment and integration approach.

· Build the first working system hands\-on while creating the foundation for later engineering scale.

· Set standards for code quality, repository structure, release management, testing and documentation.

· Translate psychometric, assessment and reporting requirements into reliable product workflows.

· Design systems that are simple enough to ship quickly and strong enough to evolve over time.

AI, Automation and Workflow Design

· Integrate AI APIs for controlled support in item review, report drafting, insight generation and quality checks.

· Build human\-in\-the\-loop approval flows so AI supports judgement without replacing governance.

· Automate repetitive internal processes across review queues, exports, report delivery, logs and client operations.

· Use no\-code or low\-code tools where appropriate, but avoid fragile workflows that cannot scale.

· Create reusable internal tools for content, review, versioning, QA, publishing and support.

Security, Data and Governance

· Implement secure authentication, role\-based permissions and controlled access for internal and external users.

· Maintain clean separation of respondent data, assessment content, scoring logic, client accounts and reports.

· Build audit trails for item changes, scoring updates, report changes, exports and approvals.

· Support practical privacy, confidentiality and data\-security expectations for enterprise clients.

· Plan reliable backup, rollback, incident logging and production monitoring practices from the beginning.

Team and Vendor Enablement

· Work directly with the founder, psychometricians, content developers, reviewers and business stakeholders.

· Convert incomplete business notes into clear technical requirements and ship\-ready tasks.

· Guide junior developers, interns, freelancers or vendors as the technology team expands.

· Create documentation that allows the product to be maintained without founder dependence.

· Represent the technology plan with confidence in internal reviews and partner discussions.

**First 90\-Day Outcome**

A strong candidate should be able to create a clean technical blueprint, stabilize the core data model, build the first usable assessment flow, create admin/review foundations, and demonstrate AI\-assisted reporting or review workflow prototypes within the first 90 days.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

Required Capability Profile

· Strong hands\-on full\-stack development capability; able to build without a large team.

· Experience building SaaS, web applications, internal platforms or product MVPs from scratch.

· Comfort with backend architecture, database design, APIs, authentication and deployment.

· Good judgement on when to use custom code, AI tools, automation platforms and low\-code systems.

· Ability to work in ambiguity, ask sharp questions and convert requirements into working releases.

· High ownership mindset with founder\-track energy, accountability and speed.

· Strong written documentation habits and structured communication with non\-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Technical Stack / Tool Exposure

**Frontend**

React, Next.js, Vue or equivalent modern web framework

**Backend**

Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Django, Express or equivalent backend stack

**Database**

PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB or similar structured data systems

**AI / LLMs**

OpenAI, Gemini, Claude APIs; prompt orchestration; human\-in\-the\-loop workflows

**Automation**

Apps Script, Zapier, Make, n8n, Notion APIs, Google Workspace integrations

**Deployment**

Vercel, AWS, GCP, Render, Railway or similar cloud deployment environments

**Engineering Discipline**

GitHub, CI/CD basics, logging, monitoring, documentation and issue tracking

Good to Have

· Prior experience in HR tech, edtech, assessment platforms, learning platforms or B2B SaaS.

· Understanding of surveys, psychometrics, scoring models, dashboards or report generation.

Its global teams manage settlement activity, risk and control, while ensuring the delivery of regulatory compliance and seamless operational client service across 60 countries.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Accurate and timely processing of all Interbank FX deals done by Front office within appropriate cut off times.
* Accurate and timely reporting of trades to Trade repository including trade life cycle events
* across the products.
* Monitoring of Trade Matching Platforms
* Accurate processing of all Corporate FX deals done by Front office
* Ensure all confirmations and payments are sent in time
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal control requirements
* Ensure all required documents are received from Client on timely basis
* Ensure appropriate action taken and responses are provided as per the agreed TAT
* To provide internal customers with the highest level of service through understanding customer needs and establishing good relationships, with improvement from benchmark by year end
* Support new Treasury business initiatives
* Maintain a high level of control over correspondence both internal and external
* To be updated with Regulations and Policies
* Contribute to sustaining team morale and motivation within the department
* Ensure atmosphere of the team is maintained with open communication amongst the team and with managers
* Provide suggestions and assist in streamlining processes with a view to reducing manual effort and achieving higher efficiency/accuracy and cost savings
* Ensure strict cost control discipline

**Role requirements / Educational Qualifications / Certification / Experience:**


HSBC Treasury has to operate in an environment which is highly controlled and regulated through numerous laws and regulations. The jobholder is guided by the Global Banking \& Markets FIM, RBI's Exchange Control manual and various guidelines issued from time to time, FEMA, FEDAI \& FIMMDA guidelines, Internal Control guidelines and market best practices.


Any discrepancy on this desk may directly result into regulatory default or non\-compliance, major challenge for this desk is to maintain a high level of accuracy while adhering to extremely demanding time constraints. Jobholder should strive to build robust intraday controls to mitigate such defaults/ risks.


Jobholder needs to ensure that effective checks and balances are in place and timely and accurate information is submitted.


The thinking challenge in the job is to suggest ways to streamline workflows to cut processing time without compromising on controls. To ensure that electronic settlement mechanisms are implemented without any compromise on controls.

**Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage**

**Additional Information**

* + *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*
	+ *As per the RBI mandated Capacity Building Certification Requirement for Bank, this role requires the candidate to have the required certification / equivalent qualification before the selection for the above role. Refer to RBI Mandated Capacity Building Policy on HR Direct.*

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. *Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

**Role Objectives**

To manage and execute the complete rhodium plating process for gold jewellery, ensuring superior surface finish, uniform coating thickness, high\-quality aesthetics, and adherence to production timelines. The role is responsible for maintaining plating quality standards, minimizing rework, and ensuring safe handling of chemicals while supporting bulk and customized order execution.

**Role Responsibilities**

**Rhodium Operation**

· Execute end\-to\-end rhodium plating process for all jewellery categories including rings, bangles, necklaces, earrings, and customized pieces.

· Plan daily plating activities based on production schedules and dispatch priorities.

· Ensure proper pre\-plating preparation including ultrasonic cleaning, buffing, degreasing, and activation.

· Maintain correct bath parameters such as temperature, voltage, current density, and chemical concentration.

· Ensure uniform rhodium thickness as per company quality standards.

· Handle white gold, yellow gold masking, and selective rhodium plating requirements.

**Chemical \& Bath Management**

· Prepare and maintain rhodium solution, replenishment cycles, and filtration processes.

· Monitor chemical usage and control wastage of precious rhodium metal.

· Maintain records of bath life, consumption, and recovery processes.

**·** Ensure proper precious metal recovery from drag\-out and rinsing.

**Quality Control**

· Inspect jewellery before and after plating to ensure scratch\-free, stain\-free, and high\-lustre finish.

· Monitor adhesion, color consistency, and durability of plating.

· Identify defects such as burning, patchiness, peeling, or dull finish and take corrective action.

· Work closely with QC team to reduce rejection and rework percentage.

**Tool Handling \& Maintenance**

· Operate rectifiers, plating tanks, ultrasonic machines, and drying equipment.

· Ensure preventive maintenance of plating equipment.

· Maintain clean\-room discipline to avoid contamination.

· Follow all safety norms for handling acids, chemicals, and electrical equipment.

· Use PPE and maintain proper ventilation and waste disposal systems.

· Ensure environmental and regulatory compliance in plating operations.

**Production Target Achievement:**

* Complete assigned daily production targets within timelines while maintaining quality standards.

**Process Coordination**

* Ensure proper handover of finished ornament to respective department with correct labelling and documentation

**Documentation \& Reporting**

· Maintain daily production logs, rejection reports, chemical consumption records, and recovery data.

· Provide plating status updates against order timelines

**Minimum Qualification**

· Graduate in Chemical

**Desired Qualification**

· Diploma / Degree in Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, or Jewellery Manufacturing Technology.

· Certification in Electroplating Technology or Precious Metal Finishing is preferred.

**Experience**

· 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in rhodium plating within a gold jewellery manufacturing environment.

· Experience handling high\-value jewellery, designer pieces, and export\-quality finishing preferred.

**Mandatory Skills**

· Rhodium plating chemistry \& bath control

· Surface preparation, masking \& selective plating

· Colour tone \& micron thickness control

· Precious metal handling \& recovery

· Jewellery finishing standards knowledge

· Plating defect troubleshooting

· Electroplating safety awareness

· Team coordination with polishing, QC \& production

· Strong attention to detail

title: Executive Assistant to Founder
description:
**Reports to: Founder** 

**Location: Khar, Mumbai, on\-site**

**Type: Full\-time**

**Experience: 0 to 3 years. Freshers with the right attitude welcome**

**About the role**

This is a high\-trust support role for a founder running multiple businesses. Your job is simple to state and hard to do well: make sure the right information, the right people and the right follow\-ups reach the founder at the right time, and that nothing slips through the cracks. You free up his hours so he can spend them on building the business.

**What you will do**

* Manage the founder's calendar, meetings, scheduling and daily priorities.
* Triage inbox and messages, draft routine replies, and ensure nothing falls through.
* Track and follow up on open items across the team, vendors and partners. Chase what was committed, confirm it got done, and flag slippage early.
* Keep information organised: pull together reports and data from the team, especially ecommerce operations, into clean, ready\-to\-review form so the founder can decide quickly. You organise and present the data; the founder interprets and decides.
* Coordinate between the founder and the operations team: relay, schedule, document and follow up.
* Prepare review packs and meeting notes, and capture and circulate action points.
* Handle travel, logistics and ad\-hoc professional and personal coordination.

**What good looks like**

* Extremely organised. Nothing slips. You are the one who remembers what everyone else forgot.
* Strong written and spoken English and Hindi.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and Google Workspace, and quick to learn new tools.
* Proactive. You chase and flag without being told twice.
* Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive business and personal information.
* Calm and steady in a fast\-moving, multi\-business environment.
* Attitude over experience. We will train the right person.

**What this role is not**

This is not a decision\-making or operations\-management role. You make sure the right information and people reach the founder at the right time. The calls are his to make.

**Why this role is worth it**

For the right person, this is a launchpad. Sitting beside a founder across five businesses, you will learn how multiple ventures are actually run day to day. Strong performers can grow into operations, ecommerce or business roles across the group.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: MOTHER TEACHER
description:
A mother teacher in an educational setting is essentially an educator who combines the nurturing and caring qualities of a mother with the instructional responsibilities of a teacher. This role is particularly prominent in early childhood education, where the focus is on creating a warm, supportive, and engaging learning environment for young children. Mother teachers prioritize not only academic development but also the social, emotional, and overall well\-being of their students. Here's a more detailed breakdown of the responsibilities and qualities associated with a mother teacher:Key Responsibilities:

* **Creating a Nurturing Environment:**Mother teachers strive to establish a safe, inclusive, and comforting classroom atmosphere where children feel secure, valued, and encouraged to learn.
* **Age\-Appropriate Instruction:**They develop and implement engaging, age\-appropriate lessons and activities across various subjects, ensuring a balance of instruction, demonstration, and hands\-on learning.
* **Holistic Child Development:**Mother teachers focus on fostering not only cognitive development but also the social, emotional, and physical growth of each child.

* **Assessment and Evaluation:**Mother teachers assess student progress through various methods and provide feedback to students and parents.
* **Curriculum Implementation:**They follow the prescribed curriculum while adapting it to meet the specific needs and interests of their students.

* **Professional Development:**They participate in ongoing professional development activities to enhance their teaching skills and stay updated on best practices.

Essential Qualities:

* **Patience and Empathy:**Mother teachers possess a high degree of patience and empathy, allowing them to understand and respond to children's individual needs and emotions.
* **Warmth and Caring:**They create a warm and caring atmosphere in the classroom, making children feel loved and supported.
* **Strong Communication Skills:**Mother teachers communicate effectively with both children and parents, fostering positive relationships and collaboration.
* **Creativity and Adaptability:**They demonstrate creativity in developing engaging lessons and activities and adapt their teaching strategies to meet diverse learning styles.
* **Organizational Skills:**They are well\-organized, managing the classroom, materials, and student records effectively.
* **Observational Skills:**Mother teachers are observant, noticing subtle cues and changes in children's behavior and learning.

title: Designer - Science Learning / STEM Curriculum (Hyderabad)
description:
**Designer \- Science Learning / STEM Curriculum**

**Organization:** Yardstick Educational Initiatives

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Work Mode:** Work from Office

**Function:** Product

**Type:** Full\-Time

**Openings:** 2–3

**About Yardstick \& BeeCurious**

Yardstick Educational Initiatives is the organisation behind BeeCurious — a STEM education initiative dedicated to making learning engaging, experiential, and future\-ready for school students. Through hands\-on STEM programs, project\-based learning experiences, and innovative educational solutions, BeeCurious helps students develop critical thinking, creativity, problem\-solving, and innovation skills.

We partner with schools to deliver high\-quality STEM learning experiences that complement classroom education and prepare students for the challenges of tomorrow. Our stakeholders include school leaders, principals, educators, students, and parents who share our vision of transforming learning through curiosity\-driven education.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a candidate to join the BeeCurious product team. This is a hands\-on, creative role at the heart of what we do — designing science and mathematics activities that students build, test, and learn from inside the classroom.

You will own both sides of the work: the activity itself and the curriculum around it. That means you will conceptualise new hands\-on activities, source and experiment with materials, prototype and iterate until the activity works flawlessly, and then write the student worksheet and teacher guide that make the learning stick. These are not separate jobs done by separate people — you will do both, and the quality of one will always inform the other.

Freshers are welcome. If you have the right background and the right mindset, we will teach you the rest.

This role is for someone who genuinely loves science, finds joy in making things work, and believes that the best way to understand how the world works is to build something and see what happens.

**Key ResponsibilitiesActivity Conceptualisation \& Design**

* Conceptualise new hands\-on science and mathematics activities — think creatively about what phenomena can be explored with simple, accessible materials.
* Coordinate with the supply and production teams to source materials for prototyping; identify new materials and creative solutions when standard options do not meet the requirement.
* Work with the in\-house design expert to ensure that the final activity is visually appealing, easy to assemble, and aesthetically engaging for students.
* Ensure the kit design is clean and intuitive — all components fit together without friction, assembly and disassembly are smooth, and there are no loose ends.

**Prototyping \& Iterative Testing**

* Build and test prototypes hands\-on — repeatedly, rigorously, and with a critical eye.
* Test every aspect of the activity: the working of the science, the assembly process, the durability of materials, and the experience of a student encountering it for the first time.
* Iterate through multiple cycles of design, testing, and refinement. Getting it right the first time is not the expectation — getting it right is.
* Document findings from each iteration and use them to drive the next improvement.

**Curriculum Writing — Student Worksheet**

* Write the student worksheet for each activity, structured to guide students through the experience and maximise the learning value.
* Each worksheet should include: a compelling introduction to the activity, a clear materials list, a step\-by\-step procedure, scaffolded spaces to capture observations and inferences, and inquiry\-based questions that push students to think about what they saw and why.
* Frame questions using the Claim–Evidence–Reasoning approach so students develop the habit of grounding their conclusions in what they observed.
* Ensure the worksheet language is age\-appropriate, clear, and engaging — written for the student, not the teacher.

**Curriculum Writing — Teacher Guide**

* Write the accompanying teacher guide for each activity, providing complete facilitation support.
* Include step\-by\-step instructions for running the activity in a classroom, safety guidance, answers to all student worksheet questions, and pedagogical context explaining the science behind the activity.

**Curriculum \& Standards Alignment**

* Map each activity to the relevant curriculum frameworks — NCERT, ICSE, and the Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS) — and ensure the learning outcomes are clearly addressed.
* Ensure every activity is educationally purposeful: the hands\-on experience should connect directly to a concept students are learning in their curriculum.

**Ownership \& Coordination**

* Take full ownership of each activity from initial concept to final, production\-ready deliverable.
* Coordinate proactively with the supply chain team to ensure materials are available when needed; follow up consistently and resolve sourcing challenges without waiting to be asked.
* Keep the Product Head informed of progress, blockers, and iterations at every stage.

**Who You Are**

* **Passionate about science — genuinely, not on paper** You are the kind of person who looks at a spinning top and wonders why it doesn't fall over, or takes apart a broken device just to see how it works. Science is not something you studied; it is something you are curious about. That curiosity is what will make you good at this job.
* **Creative and inventive** You can look at a handful of EVA foam, a DC motor, a straw, and some wire and imagine three different things a student could build with them. You enjoy the puzzle of turning a scientific concept into a physical experience, and you are willing to try unconventional approaches to get there.
* **A problem\-solver who works through failure** Prototyping is an inherently frustrating process. Things do not work, materials behave unexpectedly, and designs that looked good on paper fall apart in practice. You do not give up when this happens — you diagnose, adapt, and try again.
* **A believer in hands\-on learning** You understand — or are deeply curious about — why learning by doing is different from learning by reading. You care about the student's experience: what they observe, what they wonder, what they take away. That care shows up in the quality of your worksheets and the attention you bring to testing.
* **An owner** You take pride in completing your work. Once an activity is yours, you see it through — the design, the testing, the writing, all of it — until it is done well. You do not consider a task finished until it meets the standard.
* **A collaborator who communicates proactively** You work closely with designers, the supply team, and the Product Head. You keep people in the loop, flag problems early, and ask for help when you need it — rather than going quiet and hoping things resolve themselves.

**Essential Requirements**

The following are mandatory qualifications for this role. Applications that do not meet these criteria will not be considered.

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics or Engineering. Candidates with a background in Chemistry or Biology will also be considered, though Physics and Engineering are strongly preferred.
* **Mindset:** A genuine passion for science and hands\-on learning — evident through coursework, personal projects, or any other avenue. This is as important as the degree.
* Freshers are welcome to apply — no prior work experience is required.

**Preferred**

* Any exposure to designing or facilitating science activities, experiments, or demonstrations — in a classroom, club, lab, internship, or personal project setting.
* Familiarity with curriculum frameworks such as NCERT, ICSE, or NGSS.
* Any experience writing curriculum, instructional content, or study material.
* Basic comfort with productivity tools — spreadsheets, documents, and project tracking.

**The Opportunity**

Most science graduates spend their careers explaining science that already exists. At BeeCurious, you will spend yours creating the experience through which students encounter it for the first time.

Every activity you design will be used by real students in real classrooms across India. When a student assembles a motor, watches a coil spin for the first time, and asks "why does it keep going?" — the answer to that question, and the experience that prompted it, will be something you built.

This is creative, purposeful work for someone who loves science and wants to put that love to use in a way that matters. If that is you, we would like to meet you.

*Yardstick Educational Initiatives is an equal opportunity employer.*

description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
   

  

 At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities.  We are seeking an experienced
 **Lead Technical Writer**

**Product Requirements Documentation (PRD)**

**Developer \& User Documentation**

* Develop tutorials, FAQs, and knowledge base content
* Improve developer and user experience through structured documentation


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, QA, and UX teams
* Participate in agile development processes and release cycles
* Ensure documentation is accurate, up\-to\-date, and release\-ready


**Tools \& Process Improvement**
* Use tools such as Markdown, Git, Confluence, or similar
* Introduce automation and efficiency improvements in documentation workflows
* Leverage AI tools where helpful for content generation and optimization


**What We're Looking For**
* 3\-4years of experience in technical writing, including leadership experience
* Strong experience documenting data platforms, APIs, or enterprise software
* Hands\-on experience creating and managing PRDs
* Solid understanding of:
* Data workflows, ETL processes, and analytics systems
* APIs, microservices, and cloud environments
* Basic to intermediate understanding of AI/ML concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to AI/ML or data science environments
* Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or similar technologies
* Experience in Agile/Scrum environments


**What's In It For You**
 At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
   

  

* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.


**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
 Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 FactSet (NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and client\-centric specialized support. As a member of the S\&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
   

  

 At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

Shark Ninja is expanding our APAC business and scaling it rapidly. Our two brands, Shark, and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth in the past 5 years, driven mainly by the very strong innovation pipeline on both brands. Given this success in our existing markets, Shark Ninja has embarked on a bold plan for growing APAC business, in which India plays a critical role.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we are looking for a People \& Culture Generalist to join our team. This role will be based in Bangalore, India.
   

  

 What is the role?
   

  

 The People \& Culture Generalist is a hands\-on individual contributor role supporting the India business across Talent Acquisition (50%) and People Operations (50%). This role will work closely with the Head of People \& Culture, India, hiring managers, and external partners to ensure smooth hiring, robust HR operations, and compliant people processes. This is an execution\-focused role suited for someone who enjoys owning outcomes, working closely with stakeholders, and operating in a growing, fast\-moving environment.
   

  

 What are the responsibilities?
   

  

* Talent Acquisition (\~50%)
* Support hiring efforts for India roles, primarily across Sales and Marketing all functions
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and hiring timelines
* Support candidate sourcing, resume screening, interview coordination, and candidate communication
* Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Support offer coordination, documentation, and onboarding handover
* Maintain hiring data, trackers, and documentation within our ATS
* People Operations \& HR Administration (50%)
* Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing in coordination with payroll vendors, including data validation and monthly closure
* Own benefits administration, including insurance enrolments, renewals, vendor coordination, employee queries, and claims support
* Coordinate with external partners for statutory compliance and other applicable regulations
* Maintain accurate employee data and HR records with high attention to detail and confidentiality
* Support implementation of People \& Culture initiatives, policies, and processes as the organization scales


 What requirements are we looking at?
   

  

* 3–5 years of experience in an HR Generalist or People \& Culture role
* Prior hands\-on experience supporting recruitment activities (sourcing, screening, coordination)
* Experience managing or supporting payroll processing with external vendors
* Working knowledge of Indian HR operations and compliance (good to have)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Clear, professional communication skills with internal and external stakeholders
* Comfortable with operational, execution\-heavy work in a growing environment
* High standards of ownership, integrity, and confidentiality


 What is a great mindset?
   

  

* Mindset of “RARELY SATISFIED”
* Make things better each day by iteration — “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
* Understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE”
* Deliver something great together — “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
* Be clear and honest — “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT”

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 VERIQ is India's first Aadhaar\-verified social experience marketplace. Think Airbnb for real\-world experiences. Verified third\-party hosts list curated experiences across dining, travel, and social gatherings. Verified users discover and book. We are building the social infrastructure India never had.
 



 Stop Matching. Start Meeting.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 VERIQ is pre\-launch and growing fast. This is a founding team HR role. You will build our people function from zero. No playbook exists yet. You will write it.
 



 You will own recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations for a lean, remote\-first team. You will partner directly with the founder to define HR policies, manage the employee lifecycle, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations. This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and genuinely cares about building a great team culture from day one.
 



  





**Salary: 20000\-50000 INR/month** 




  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to offer for all roles across tech, operations, and growth
* Build and manage onboarding for a remote\-first team across India
* Define and implement HR policies, processes, and documentation from scratch
* Manage contract documentation, compliance, and workforce planning
* Support performance management and retention initiatives
* Partner with leadership on people strategy as the company scales
* Coordinate with external partners including legal, payroll, and compliance as needed



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in a core HR role such as HR Manager or HRBP
* Prior experience in a startup or early\-stage company is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of employment law, remote team compliance, and HR best practices
* Excellent communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management skills
* Proficiency with HRIS tools, documentation, and data management
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and move fast
* Relevant experience matters more than formal qualifications



  





**Why Join VERIQ** 



* Founding team role where you shape the culture from day one
* Direct access to the founder with no bureaucracy or layers
* Remote and flexible so you can work from anywhere in India
* Be part of something real as we solve urban loneliness at scale



  





 For any queries please reach out to info@veriqconnect.com

title: Training Manager
description:
**About Sutherland**




 Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
 



 We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market\-leading technology and business process excellence.
 



 We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.
 



 For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivaed Training Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and delivering impactful training programs that enhance employee performance, customer experience, and operational excellence. You will collaborate closely with project’s leadership and cross\-functional teams to ensure training initiatives align with business goals and industry best practices.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* **Training program design** 
 : Develop and implement comprehensive training programs.
* **Needs assessment** 
 : Conduct training needs analyses to identify skill gaps and create targeted learning solutions.
* **Onboarding excellence** 
 : Lead onboarding programs to ensure new hires quickly adapt to tools, and processes.
* Client and internal connects
 **: Build strong relationships with stakeholders and internal teams to align training priorities and share best practices.**
* Standardized processes
 **: Establish unified training and quality processes across all geographies to ensure consistency and scalability.**
* **Performance improvement** 
 : Monitor training effectiveness through KPIs and feedback, adjusting programs for maximum impact.
* **AI\-driven knowledge:** 
 Implement AI\-powered knowledge management tools to streamline content delivery, personalize learning, and provide real\-time insights for trainers and employees.
* **Collaboration** 
 : Partner with operations, customer support, and quality teams to align training with organizational priorities.
* **Continuous learning** 
 : Introduce innovative learning methodologies, including digital platforms and microlearning.
* **Reporting** 
 : Prepare and present training outcomes, insights, and recommendations to senior management.
* **Mentorship** 
 : Coach and guide trainers and team members to build a strong learning culture.



**Qualifications:** 




 Our most successful candidates will have:
 


* Bachelor’s Degree
* 5–7 years of experience in training management, preferably in fast\-paced, customer\-centric industries
* Proven expertise in developing and implementing training programs that drive measurable results
* Strong knowledge of learning management systems, AI\-driven knowledge platforms, and modern training tools
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills
* Leadership experience with the ability to inspire and manage teams
* Certifications in Training \& Development (e.g., Certified Training Professional, Instructional Design) preferred
* Ability to adapt quickly to evolving priorities in a dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills to build relationships across project’s global teams and client stakeholders
* Global process governance — to support unified standards across geographies.
* Stakeholder engagement — to highlight client and internal connects.
* AI knowledge platforms — to emphasize AI‑driven training and knowledge management.

title: HR Manager – People & Culture
description:
Location \-
 **Fort, South Mumbai** 




 Type \-
 **Full\-Time, WFO** 




 Reports To \-
 **Co\-Founders** 




 CTC Range \-
 **12–18 LPA** 




  





  





**About Caresmith** 




 Caresmith is a profitable, fast\-growing D2C personal care and wellness brand. We build category\-leading products across massage \& recovery, oral care, grooming, wellness, and personal health devices, sold through our own website and leading marketplaces and quick\-commerce platforms. We are based out of Fort, South Mumbai
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring our first dedicated HR Manager to own the full people function at Caresmith. We need someone who can independently lead HR without the founders having to be involved in day\-to\-day people operations.
 



 You will report directly to the Co\-Founders and manage a small team: a Junior Recruiter (handling sourcing and pipeline administration) and an Admin Executive (handling office operations and vendor coordination).
 



 The core problems you are being hired to solve: our performance management system exists but needs to be sharpened with role\-specific, measurable KRAs and real accountability; recruitment cycles are too slow; employee issues land on the founders' desks because there is no one positioned to resolve them at the HR level; and culture and engagement are waiting to be owned deliberately. We need someone who can improve what exists, build what’s missing, and run it all without hand\-holding
 **.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Critical Priorities** 




**Performance Managemen** 
 t: We have a performance management system in place, but it needs significant improvement. Your job is to make it role\-specific with measurable KRAs and outcomes, tighten the review cadence, and equip managers to give honest, data\-backed feedback. The system exists \- you need to make it actually work.
 



  





**Recruitment Velocit** 
 y: Own the hiring pipeline end\-to\-end. We source candidates in\-house using recruitment platforms and prefer to keep it that way. You will drive sourcing strategy, direct the Junior Recruiter on candidate identification and outreach, manage the screening and interview process, and ensure open roles close within defined timelines. Own stakeholder alignment on role requirements, candidate quality, and offer decisions. The goal is that founders or reporting managers approve final candidates, not chase recruiters for updates.
 



  





**Ongoing Ownership** 



* **People Operations:** 
 Own the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, documentation, confirmations, exits. Ensure HRMS data is accurate and up to date. Coordinate payroll inputs with the outsourced partner on time every month.
* **Compliance \& Policy:** 
 Ensure Caresmith stays compliant with all labour laws, statutory requirements (PF, ESI, PT, Shops \& Establishments), and POSH. Own the HR policy manual, keep it current, and make sure policies are actually followed — not just documented.
* **Culture \& Engagement:** 
 Take deliberate ownership of employee engagement — not just events and celebrations, but the quality of everyday interactions, feedback channels, and team connectedness. At our scale, culture is shaped by a handful of people. You are one of them.
* **Administration Oversight:** 
 Supervise the Admin Executive on office operations, vendor management, and IT asset tracking. The goal is that admin runs smoothly without things falling through the cracks.
* **HR Systems \& Process:** 
 Ensure the HRMS is properly configured and actually used. Build dashboards that give leadership real visibility into people metrics (attrition, hiring funnel, attendance, engagement). Look at every manual HR process as something that should be automated or eliminated.



  





**R** 
 o
 **le Relation** 
 s
 **hip Scope** 




  





 Junior Recruiter \- Direct report \- Sourcing, screening, scheduling, offer
 



 Admin Executive \- Direct report \- Office ops, vendors, IT assets
 



  





**Must\-Have** 



* 5–8 years of experience as an HR generalist, with at least 2 years independently owning the full HR function (not just one vertical like recruitment or compliance)
* Experience in a startup, D2C, or high\-growth consumer brand environment (sub\-100 employee stage). You have built HR processes from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones.
* Hands\-on experience designing and running performance review cycles — not just administering a form, but coaching managers, calibrating ratings, and addressing underperformance
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law compliance, statutory requirements, and POSH
* Comfortable managing a team and coordinating with external partners (outsourced payroll/compliance vendor). Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter or similar sourcing platforms.
* Based in Mumbai with willingness to work from our Fort office full\-time



**Strong Preference** 



* Experience managing HR for a team that includes both warehouse/operations staff and office\-based employees (Caresmith has both)
* Familiarity with HRMS platforms (greytHR, Keka, Zoho People, or similar) and a track record of improving HR processes through technology
* Exposure to employer branding or recruitment marketing — making the company attractive to talent, not just filling roles
* Comfortable using AI tools to make HR operations faster and more efficient



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 This is not a corporate HR role where you inherit a fully built team and established systems. It is also not a pure recruitment role with an HR title. You will be building the people function at a company that has outgrown its current HR capability. If you are someone who needs a large team, a big budget, or detailed playbooks to operate, this will not work. If you are someone who finds energy in building systems, earning trust across a team, and making a real impact on how a company runs — this is your role.
 



  





**Qualification** 




 MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources. We will consider candidates without a formal HR degree if they have strong, demonstrable experience running the full HR function at a comparable company.

title: Employee Relations Partner
description:
About ModMed
 



 At ModMed, we are on a mission to place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty\-specific cloud platform. We envision a world where the software we build increases medical\-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
 



 Our culture is anchored in our Core Values:
 


* Create customer delight.
* Save time.
* Innovate boldly, then make things happen.
* Align passion with purpose.
* Think big. Have fun. Do good.



 If you are an HR professional who thrives on building trust, resolving complex challenges with empathy, and driving a positive, compliant workplace culture, you will find your purpose here.
 



 Position Summary
 



  





 As an integral part of the India People Team, the Employee Relations Partner will be responsible for managing local employee relations, including processes and procedures, to drive positive impacts on our workplace culture. In this role, you will partner with the local People Team, US\-based Employee Relations Partner, Legal, Benefits, and Compliance teams to develop employee relations strategy, policy, and practice. You will also ensure cross\-functional investigations and any disciplinary processes are addressed promptly, impartially, and in line with company values and applicable laws.
 



 Shift Note: This role operates on a 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST schedule to facilitate seamless real\-time collaboration, alignment, and strategic partnership with our US\-based Employee Relations and Legal counterparts.
 



  





**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 




**Employee Relations** 



* Take initiative to partner in the design, implementation, and management of strategies and continuous improvement to the employee relations framework and deliverables, including policies, procedures, and training.
* Provide guidance and support to the local People Team, People Business Partners, and leaders in resolving conflicts.
* Provide guidance on performance issues and recommend appropriate corrective actions, including disciplinary measures and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) when necessary.
* Partner with internal and external Legal teams to navigate sensitive employee issues and investigations.
* Provide support to the Legal and Litigation teams as needed, and represent the company before authorities when required.
* Create a proactive employee engagement model that improves risk mitigation through escalation standards, feedback expectations, and ongoing training.
* Partner with Training \& Development to provide training and educational programs to employees and management on HR policies, procedures, and compliance matters.
* Continually monitor and maintain company policies and procedures while anticipating change.
* Provide critical and timely input regarding the consequences and implications of local law and best practices to all internal stakeholders.
* Research employee policy trends and practices at global and local levels to help align them with legal requirements, ModMed strategies, philosophies, and programs.
* Manage local policies, including their creation and obtaining necessary approvals.
* Partner on appropriate communication plans and document storage for company policies.
* Collect and perform analysis of employment\-related data—such as turnover rates, exit interview data, and employee feedback—to identify trends and areas of improvement.



**Investigations** 



* Manage and conduct local workplace investigations in response to a range of employee relations concerns, including harassment, discrimination, retaliation, and violations of policies.
* Partner with the local POSH committee as appropriate for any claims related to sexual harassment.
* Prepare comprehensive investigation reports with findings to include the evaluation of any process gaps or practices that create legal risk in order to mitigate organizational liability.
* Maintain and protect accurate, confidential records regarding all investigations.



  





**Experience and Skills Requirements** 



* Experience: 8\+ years of dedicated Employee Relations experience, including a proven track record of conducting investigations in India, with a strong understanding of local cultural norms.
* Shift Flexibility: Must be comfortable working a consistent mid\-shift from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST to maintain overlap with global stakeholders.
* Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding and application of internal and external HR principles, concepts, practices, and standards related to workplace harassment investigations.
* Confidentiality: Absolute ability to protect confidentiality and personal privacy while handling sensitive documents and records in a highly professional manner.
* Influence \& Trust: Experience demonstrating effective consultation and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust\-based relationships at all levels of the organization.
* Proactivity: Proven ability to take initiative to develop and demonstrate Employee Relations value to the broader ModMed organization.
* Conflict Resolution: Successful experience with constructive confrontation, conflict resolution, and deep analytical problem\-solving (including problem assessment and solution generation).
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Coaching: Ability to build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization, and the capability to objectively coach cross\-functional partners through complex issues.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to competently analyze and synthesize complex documents and data to arrive at objective findings.



  





**Education Requirements** 



* Required: Graduate (Bachelor’s Degree) in Business Management with a specialization in HR.
* Preferred: Post Graduate Degree or Law Degree.

 You will lead the HR team for the Chennai region. You will be responsible for day\-to\-day people management and ensuring strategy is translated appropriately to the local level.

 As a member of the country HR management team, you will define the HR strategy in line with the broader regional HR strategy. You’ll assess industry and market trends and situations to develop and implement HR initiatives in line with the market operational needs.
   

  





**Retaining talent.** 
 You will collaborate with HRBPs, Market HR and business leaders to implement retention strategies to retain the best talent in your hub.

 You will partner with your business leaders and on Talent Reviews, identifying high\-potential employees, developing succession plans down to L2 and some L3s, and coaching leaders on career development. You’ll lead Market HR teams to support the roll out of global development initiatives and programs within the region and support the implementation and development of regional initiatives as determined by the regional HR leader.
   

  





**Organizational effectiveness.** 
 In collaboration with your respective HR leader, you will consult on business needs and collaborate with leaders and relevant stakeholders on transformation initiatives such as organization design, workforce planning and workflow changes. Identify key competencies and new role profiles. You will develop data\-driven business cases for location strategy, compensation changes, talent planning etc. You will partner with leaders on strategic resourcing discussions and decision making, (e,g, reduction in force, hiring ahead of the curve, down banding, out of cycle compensation reviews etc.)
   

  





**Employee relations, labor relations and performance management.** 
 You will lead your team in the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures that reflect market conditions and company philosophy, ensuring fairness and equity. You’ll oversee appropriate resolution of employee relations issues within your region, handling directly where appropriate. You’ll identify situations that require performance improvement plans (PIP) (L3 level and below) and ensure local execution with relevant leaders and managers; advising HRBPs on local requirements, templates and processes related to senior (L2\+) level PIPs.
   

  





**Culture, values and Diversity, equity and inclusion (DE\&I)**

You will lead your team to coach and guide managers and associates on all local processes such as performance management, total rewards, employee engagement, career conversations and conflict management. You’ll engage talent within your geography, deploying geographically relevant programs as appropriate to complement the global strategy.
   

  





**Change management and communication.** 
 You will lead transformation and change initiatives within your geography and effectively communicate HR policies and practices to employees at all levels in your markets. You’ll design detailed and effective change management plans, collaborating with relevant stakeholders on implementation. You will demonstrate ongoing leadership to ensure transformation is fully implemented and results in lasting change.
   

  





**Financial acumen.** 
 You will collaborate with the finance organization and your respective HR leader, demonstrating financial acumen and understanding how people strategies impact our financials. You demonstrate a detailed understanding of the Operating Plan for the geography you support and ensure talent decisions are made with key financial metrics in mind.
   

  





**Labour Compliance.** 
 You will ensure the organization complies with all relevant laws and regulations relating to HR, including labor laws, employment standards, local norms, and partner with security team on health and safety regulations.

* Master’s degree in human resources or equivalent business experience
* 12\+ years of relevant experience, with at least 5\+ years in a senior HRBP or similar role

* Experience in rolling out large\-scale initiatives requiring extensive change management, leadership buy\-in, implementation, and execution.
* Proven ability to align leadership across conflicting priorities and viewpoints, with advanced influencing skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, programme management, and problem\-solving skills.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 4\-6 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g., Recruitment, core HR etc)
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* A keen interest in self\-learning and seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects.
* A collaborative approach to working in a team environment.
* A self\-starter, independent thinker, curious and creative, with passion and drive.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK (United Kingdom) – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines.

description:
Ninja Van is a late\-stage logtech startup that is disrupting a massive industry with innovation and cutting edge technology. Launched 2014 in Singapore, we have grown rapidly to become one of Southeast Asia's largest and fastest\-growing express logistics companies. Since our inception, we’ve delivered to 100 million different customers across the region with added predictability, flexibility and convenience. Join us in our mission to connect shippers and shoppers across Southeast Asia to a world of new possibilities.
   

  

**More About Us**
* We process 250 million API requests and 3TB of data every day.
* We deliver more than 2 million parcels every day.
* 100% network coverage with 2600\+ hubs and stations in 6 SEA markets (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam and Philippines), reaching 500 million consumers.
* 2 Million active shippers in all e\-commerce segments, from the largest marketplaces to the individual social commerce sellers.
* Raised more than US$500 million over five rounds.


 We are looking for world\-class talent to join our crack team of engineers, product managers and designers. We want people who are passionate about creating software that makes a difference to the world. We like people who are brimming with ideas and who take initiative rather than wait to be told what to do. We prize team\-first mentality, personal responsibility and tenacity to solve hard problems and meet deadlines. As part of a small and lean team, you will have a very direct impact on the success of the company.
   

  

 The Regional Data Analytics Engineer helps to maintain the data platform, including the enterprise data warehouse and BI tools, which is the primary interface through which users interact with data.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business users and data analysts to understand user requirements
* Design data models to meet critical product and business needs, including reporting, data analysis, data science, and other production applications

* Monitor data warehouse usage and optimize performance and cost through data modelling best practices
* Maintain data warehouse documentation (data catalog) in collaboration with data analysts and data engineers
* Implement and manage data quality monitoring tools
* Contribute to data warehousing processes and standards to enhance team productivity and output quality
* Provide user administration, documentation, training materials, and end\-user support
* Stay updated with the latest tools and technologies in data engineering and analytics
* Evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies for BI users

* 2–4 years of experience in Data Analytics and Data Engineering
* Hands\-on experience with: Data Modelling, SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark, Presto, Hive, Bash, Linux, Git, GCP, Airflow, and REST APIs
* Programming experience is a plus
* Strong competency in Analytics and Computational Modelling, Business Needs Analysis, Data Visualisation, and Stakeholder Management
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or Statistics

 Backend: Play (Java 8\+), Golang, Node.js , Python, FastAPI

description:
**About Helpshift**
 Helpshift is a leading customer service platform powered by AI and automation, helping businesses deliver exceptional customer support experiences across digital channels. We are looking for passionate AI Engineers who are eager to build intelligent systems using the latest advancements in Generative AI, NLP, and Machine Learning.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As an Entry\-Level AI Engineer, you will work with experienced engineers and data scientists to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions. You will contribute to building conversational AI systems, intelligent automation workflows, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and machine learning applications that enhance customer support experiences.
   

  

 This role is ideal for candidates with a strong foundation in Python, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, and MLOps who are excited about solving real\-world problems using AI technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain AI/ML applications using Python
* Build and optimize NLP pipelines for text processing, classification, information extraction, and semantic search
* Develop Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases and embedding models
* Design prompts and evaluate LLM responses for quality and performance
* Collaborate with senior engineers to deploy and monitor AI applications in production
* Build APIs and AI services using frameworks such as FastAPI
* Assist in model training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and experimentation
* Work with MLOps tools to automate model deployment, monitoring, and versioning
* Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and documentation activities
* Stay updated with emerging AI, NLP, and Generative AI technologies


**Requirements**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong programming skills in Python
* Understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms
* Knowledge of Machine Learning fundamentals
* Understanding of Natural Language Processing (NLP) concepts:
+ Tokenization
+ Embeddings
+ Text Classification
+ Named Entity Recognition (NER)
+ Semantic Search
+ Transformer Models

* Understanding of Generative AI concepts:
+ Large Language Models (LLMs)
+ Prompt Engineering
+ RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation)
+ Fine\-tuning concepts
+ AI Agent fundamentals

* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks:
+ PyTorch or TensorFlow
+ Hugging Face Transformers
+ LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks


**MLOps Knowledge**

* Familiarity with:
+ Docker
+ Git/GitHub
+ CI/CD concepts
+ Kubernetes (basic understanding)
+ ML experiment tracking tools (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, etc.)


**Database \& API Skills**
* Basic knowledge of SQL databases
* Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or ChromaDB
* Understanding of REST APIs and FastAPI


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field
* Hands\-on academic projects, internships, or personal projects in AI/ML
* Experience building chatbots, AI assistants, or NLP applications
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects are a plus
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure


**What We Look For**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Passion for AI, Machine Learning, and emerging technologies
* Curiosity to learn and experiment with new AI frameworks and tools
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment


**Nice\-to\-Have Projects**
 Candidates who have built any of the following will stand out:
   

  

* AI Chatbot using LLMs

* AI Agent using LangChain or LlamaIndex

title: Power BI Developer
description:
**About the role:** 




  





 As a Power BI Developer –BIs Data Visualization, you will play a pivotal role in designing and delivering exceptional business intelligence experiences that empower our organization to make data\-driven decisions. You will leverage your deep expertise in Power BI, DAX, and data modeling to build interactive, high\-impact dash boards and reporting solutions that tell compelling data stories. This role demands a strong visualization mindset, sharp design sensibilities, and the ability to partner closely with business stakeholders to turn raw data into insight. A working knowledge of data engineering and cloud data platform is required to support your reporting layer.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  





**Data Visualizations Dashboard Development:** 




  





 • Design and build interactive, visually compelling Power BI dashboards and reports that bring data to life and enable confident decision\-making.
 



 • Apply strong visual design principles—clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling—to deliver dashboards that are both insightful and easy to consume.
 



 • Drive adoption of self\-service BI by partnering with business users to design intuitive, reusable reporting assets
 



  





**DAX s Data Modeling:** 




  





 • Develop advanced DAX measures, calculated columns, and KPIs to support complex analytical scenarios.
 



 • Design and maintain semantic data models in Power BI (star/snowflake schemas, relationships, hierarchies) optimized for performance and usability.
 



 • Build robust dimensional models (facts, dimensions, slowly changing dimensions) tailored to business analytics use cases and aligned with enterprise data warehouse design.
 



 • Translate complex business logic into clean, reusable data models that support both curated and ad\-hoc reporting needs.
 



 • Implement row\-level security, role\-based access, and work space governance for enterprise\-grade reporting.
 



  





**Cross\-Tool Visualization (Bonus):** 




  





 • Hands\-on exposure to Tableau and/or Looker is a strong plus—ability to deliver across visualization platforms as needed.
 



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration:** 




  





 • Partner with analysts, product owners, and business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate the min to elegant visualization solutions.
 



 • Conduct dashboard walkthroughs, gather feedback, and continuously iterate to improve user experience.
 



  





**Supporting Data Engineering's Cloud Data:** 




  





 • Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and prepare data for reporting.
 



 • Support light ETL/ELT activities—basic pipelines, data refreshes, and source integrations—to ensure reporting layers are reliable and up\-to\-date
 



 • Work hands\-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, or Redshift)to source, model, and consume data for reporting.
 



 • Connect Power BI to cloud data sources, optimize query folding, and design efficient data refresh strategies across Direct Query, Import, and Composite models.
 



 • Collaborate with data engineering teams on upstream data models, transformations, and pipeline dependencies.
 



  





**Performances Data Quality:** 




  





 • Optimize Power BI datasets, queries, and visuals for performance and scalability.
 



 • Apply basic data validations and quality checks to ensure trustworthy reporting outputs.
 



  





**On your first day, we'll expect you to have:** 




  





 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, ora related field.
 



 • 3–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Power BI Developer/BI Visualization Developer.
 



 • Strong expertise in DAX, Power Query(M), and data modeling within Power BI.
 



 • Solid understanding of dimension all modeling concepts —star schema, snowflake schema, facts, dimensions, and SCDs.
 



 • Exceptional data visualization skills—a proven eye for design, story telling, and dashboard UX.
 



 • Solid SQL skills with experience working across data base systems such as SQL Server, Postgres, Snowflake, or Redshift.
 



 • Hands\-on experience consuming data from cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, or Redshift.
 



 • Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and basic exposure to tools such as Azure Data Factory or Databricks.
 



 • Familiarity with Python for light scripting and data manipulation.
 



 • Basic understanding of data serialization formats like JSON, Parquet, or CSV
 



  





**We'd be super excited if you have:** 




  





 • Hands\-on experience with Tableau and/or Looker
 



 • A strong dashboard portfolio show casing visualization design depth
 



 • Deeper exposure to cloud\-based data ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP)
 



 • Ability to interact with RESTAPIs and perform basic web scraping tasks
 



 • Power BI certifications (PL\-300orequivalent)
 



  





**Benefits** 
 :
 



 At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.
 



  





 Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
 



  





 We believe diversity drives innovation. We' recommitted to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone—regardless of background, identity, or experience—has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Cloud Engineer
   

 Role Overview:
   


 We are seeking a motivated and technically sound Cloud Engineer with 6 months to 1 year of hands\-on experience, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure and basic exposure to other cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. The successful candidate will support cloud infrastructure operations, assist in deploying and managing Azure\-based services, and contribute to building scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your Azure cloud career within a collaborative, innovation\-driven team.
   




 Key Responsibilities:
   


 • Provision and manage Azure resources including Virtual Machines, Azure Blob Storage, Azure SQL, App Services, Azure Functions, and Virtual Networks.
   





 • Monitor Azure infrastructure health and performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics Workspace, and Application Insights; set up alerts and dashboards.
   





 • Support CI/CD pipeline setup and maintenance using Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts) and GitHub Actions.
   





 • Implement and manage Azure Active Directory (Azure AD / Entra ID) configurations including users, groups, conditional access, and RBAC policies.
   





 • Assist in managing Azure costs through resource tagging strategies, Azure Cost Management, budget alerts, and right\-sizing recommendations.
   





 • Maintain documentation including Azure architecture diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
   




 Required Skills \& Qualifications:
   

**Azure Core Services (Primary Focus)**

 • Compute: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Batch.
   





 • Storage: Azure Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Managed Disks.
   





 • Networking: Azure VNet, Subnets, NSGs, Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure DNS, ExpressRoute basics.
   





 • Identity \& Security: Azure AD (Entra ID), RBAC, Conditional Access, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
   





 • Monitoring: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Azure Alerts, Workbooks, and Dashboards.
   





 • DevOps: Azure DevOps (Pipelines, Repos, Boards, Artifacts), GitHub Actions for Azure deployments.
   





  




**Other Cloud Platforms (Good to Have)**

 • AWS: Basic familiarity with EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, and CloudWatch.
   





 • GCP: Awareness of Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and IAM concepts.
   





  




 Educational Qualifications
   


 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
   





 • Equivalent certifications, diploma programs, or bootcamp credentials in cloud computing are also considered.
   





  




 Certifications (Preferred)
   


 At least one Microsoft Azure certification is preferred or should be obtained within the first 3 months of joining:
   




**Microsoft Azure (Required / Primary)**

 • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\) —Plus.
   





  




**AWS (Good to Have)**

 • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA\-C03\) — Plus.
   





  




**Google Cloud (Good to Have)**

 • Associate Cloud Engineer (ACE) — Plus.

 We are looking for a Staff CloudOps Engineer with 3–4 years of hands\-on experience in AWS and Azure environments. The primary focus of this role is supporting DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automation scripting, and container orchestration. The role also involves contributing to basic cloud infrastructure management and support. You will assist in troubleshooting, support deployment pipelines, and participate in operations across cloud\-native environments.

* Collaborate with CloudOps and DevOps teams to address deployment or configuration issues.

* Experience with Terraform; exposure to CloudFormation or ARM templates is a plus.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), and Helm.

* 3–4 years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure support.
* Hands\-on experience in supporting cloud platforms like AWS and/or Azure.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms.
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure) preferred.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational shift\-based support environment.
* No location constraints

**Must haves**
* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (hands\-on)
* CI/CD: Basic experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
* Containerization: Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Docker
* Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor
* Scripting: Bash

**Good to have**

* Scripting: Python
* Security: IAM Policies, RBAC
* Observability: Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry
* Networking: VPC/VNet basics, load balancers
* Certification: AWS/Azure (Associate\-level preferred)


**What We Look For**
* Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud technologies and DevOps practices.
* Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.
* Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
* Detail\-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Nice to Have
